Issue: Appointment facility differs from the facility that owns the appointment's department
Action: Flagged. Facility-level analysis uses the recorded Appointment.FacilityID; department-level analysis uses department TYPE (10 types, identical across facilities). Ranking sensitivity tested in 5.3

Issue: Bills whose AppointmentID is not in the Appointments table (orphans)
Action: Retained in the 60k bill-level analysis; excluded from appointment-level modelling

Issue: Diagnoses whose AppointmentID is not in Appointments
Action: Excluded from appointment-level analysis

Issue: Payment rows whose bill's appointment is missing
Action: As billing

Issue: Feedback rows whose AppointmentID is not in Appointments
Action: Used only for hospital-wide rating distribution; facility/department satisfaction uses the linked rows

Issue: No Admissions, Length-of-Stay, Laboratory, Prescription or Referral tables
Action: Admission modelled through a labelled proxy (4.4); LOS, lab, prescription and referral analyses marked not computable

Issue: Phone saved in scientific notation (e.g. 2.50788E+11) -> only 6 significant digits survive; only 10 distinct values in 20,000 rows
Action: Converted to text; Phone cannot identify duplicate patients or contact anyone - excluded from analysis

Issue: Children under 12 with adult-range height/weight (height 140-190 cm, weight 40-120 kg recorded for all ages)
Action: Height/weight/BMI treated as unreliable for under-18s: BMI_clean set to missing for Age<18

Issue: Every patient (100%) has an InsuranceID (15 plans); there is no 'uninsured' category and no insurance master table
Action: Insurance coverage analysed through claims filed at billing level instead (see 4.2)

Issue: Appointments dated AFTER the analysis date (24 Oct 2026) yet carrying diagnoses, bills and feedback
Action: Flagged (future_dated); retained because they are indistinguishable from the rest of the 2026 series - results shown with and without them where it matters

Issue: Doctor's home department differs from the appointment's department
Action: Flagged; doctor workload computed per DoctorID regardless of department

Issue: Bills marked 'Paid' whose payment is below the bill amount
Action: Billing.Status treated as unreliable; Outstanding recomputed as Amount - AmountPaid

Issue: Bills marked 'Pending'/'Partially Paid' that are fully paid
Action: As above

Issue: Rating contradicts the text comment (e.g. rating 1 with 'Excellent', rating 5 with 'Poor')
Action: Rating (numeric) used as the satisfaction measure; Comment ignored (Spearman rho Rating~Comment = 0.003)

Issue: Revenue_Summary does not reconcile with Billing (summary total 1.13bn RWF vs 9.31bn billed across 60,000 bills; 60,809 summary appointments vs 5,000 appointment records)
Action: Treated as a separate management series; both are modelled and compared

Issue: All 2,000 beds have Status = 'Available' (no occupied beds recorded)
Action: Bed occupancy/utilisation is NOT computable

Issue: ChronicCondition contains the text 'None' (no chronic condition) - default parsers read it as missing
Action: Kept as a valid category 'None' (loaded with keep_default_na=False)

Issue: DateOfBirth stored as text 'm/d/yyyy' (and every DOB falls on 1 January)
Action: Converted to datetime; day/month carry no information so only birth YEAR is reliable

Issue: Possible duplicate patients on name+sex+DOB (name pool = 12 first x 10 last names; DOB always 1 Jan)
Action: Not treated as duplicates - identical by construction of a small name pool; PatientID is the only reliable key

Issue: Adult BMI outside 15-50 (extreme but arithmetically correct: BMI = weight/height^2 matches in 100% of rows)
Action: Kept and flagged (BMI_extreme); weight/height appear independently random

Issue: Under-18s recorded as Married/Widowed
Action: Flagged (implausible_profile); MaritalStatus excluded from models

Issue: Education level impossible for age (e.g. Master's under 22)
Action: Flagged; Education excluded from models

Issue: Skilled occupation recorded for children under 16
Action: Flagged; Occupation excluded from models

Issue: No registration date -> true patient-growth trend cannot be computed
Action: Proxy: cumulative unique patients by first appointment date

Issue: District, sector and village names are placeholders ('District 1', 'Sector 1', ...)
Action: Province is the finest usable geographic level; no map geometry is possible

Issue: Payment method 'Insurance' but no insurance claim exists for the bill
Action: Flagged; claim presence (not payment method) defines insurance-backed bills

Issue: No status/availability or usage field on equipment - availability and utilisation not computable
Action: Only distribution analysed

Issue: Insurance claims have only Approved/Pending statuses (no Rejected); Billing has no payment dates
Action: Claim-rejection prediction and days-to-pay analysis not possible

Issue: HC_Departments and HC_Facility_Master_Data (Departments) are identical copies
Action: Used one copy

Issue: Gender is not consistent with first name (e.g. 'Patrick' recorded Female; every name is ~50/50 male/female)
Action: Gender field used as recorded; names not used to infer sex

Issue: Blood group AB- never occurs (7 of 8 ABO/Rh groups) and group frequencies are uniform (O+ is normally most common)
Action: Used as recorded; flagged as a sign of simulated data

Issue: Status = Active for 100% of patients (no variance)
Action: Column dropped from modelling

Issue: True missing values (blank cells) across all 27 tables
Action: None required

Issue: Fully duplicated rows
Action: None found - nothing removed

Issue: Duplicate primary keys (patients, appointments, diagnoses, billing, payments, claims, feedback, beds, rooms, staff)
Action: None found - nothing removed

Issue: Impossible/inconsistent ages (Age outside 0-110 or inconsistent with DOB)
Action: Age consistent with DOB for all patients - kept

Issue: Possible duplicates on name+sex+DOB+village+blood group+height+weight
Action: Stricter key finds none/very few - nothing removed

Issue: Unparseable dates
Action: None - Date converted to datetime

Issue: Facility IDs not in HF001-HF020 / Department IDs not in master
Action: None invalid

Issue: Invalid billing amounts (<=0 or missing)
Action: None invalid (range 10,002 - 299,998 RWF)

Issue: Payments exceeding the billed amount
Action: None

Issue: Claims exceeding the billed amount
Action: None (claims are 50-100% of the bill)
